thread:
carla: Heads up — CS reported multiple customers seeing 503/502s for hosted inference starting ~02:12 UTC. Error spike across ap-south and eu-west. Raising a triage thread here.

devon: I see the same in apigw. Surge of 502/504 from gateway -> upstream auth-proxy timeouts. P50 latency for gateway jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s. Sample from logs:
```
apigw: request_id=abc123 upstream_status=502 upstream_error="connection reset" route=/v1/generate
auth-proxy: worker=7 timeout waiting for token-refresh upstream=kms-01
billing-checker: token-verify=429 retry=3
```

sam: Billing token checks show 429s and bursts of KMS throttles. Token refresh path is doing blocking calls; when billing returns 429 we retry and pile up. Possible cascade into auth-proxy thread exhaustion.

leigh: Quick config check — there was a change to token-cache TTL rolled at ~01:58 (lowered TTL to 30s) to surface stale tokens. That increases refresh frequency. Change id: cfg/auth-cache-2026-03-18. Can we revert? Also no new deploys besides that.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-1769543210. Notify-on-call: @oncall-infra. Linking runbook: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-503s>

carla: Mitigation proposal: 1) revert token-cache TTL to previous (5m) 2) restart auth-proxy pool to drain stuck workers 3) enable temporary rate-limiter on billing-checks per-tenant to avoid storming KMS 4) enable fallback route to lighter-weight model variant for high-latency requests.

maria: CS: notifying impacted trial customers now. Templated note ready, holding for confirmation after mitigation.

devon: Rolling back TTL now and restarting auth-proxy in eu-west -> initiating restart sequence.

sam: After revert + restart I'm seeing request succeed from curl test:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: application/json
{"id":"resp_01","output":"..."}
```
Errors drop from ~12% -> 0.8% in the last 5m window.

leigh: Good. Postmortem/action items we should capture now:
- root cause: token-cache TTL lowered -> excessive token refresh -> billing/KMS 429 -> auth-proxy worker exhaustion -> gateway 502/504 cascade
- short-term mitigations applied: revert TTL, restart auth-proxy, tenant-level throttles
- medium-term fixes: add backpressure/circuit for KMS calls, non-blocking token refresh with in-process locking, add autoscaling threshold on auth-proxy worker queue
- runbook updates: add checklist for token-refresh storms and billing 429 handling
- testing: add integration test that simulates billing 429 and validates graceful fallback

carla: Owners/ETA:
- devon: mitigation verification + autoscaler tweak PR (ETA: 6h)
- sam: postmortem writeup draft (ETA: 24h)
- leigh: runbook + tests (ETA: 48h)
- maria: customer comms + log of impacted tenants (ETA: 3h)

cs-bot: Notified customers: 4 tenants affected (acct-112, acct-399, acct-777, acct-998). Sending follow-up once postmortem ready.

ops-bot: Monitoring: set alert if error_rate > 2% for 5m and reopened if sustained. Incident moved to "postmortem" state.

carla: Closing active warroom. Reopen here if errors resurface or if any owner needs more time. Thanks all for quick triage. :heart:
